{{Quote|I am ''Te Corso''. The Bothan is ''Sayar Dun'La'', the Togrutan Jedi is ''Asaak Dan'', and my Nikto brother is simply ''Drok''. We bring you greetings from the Jedi Council.|Te Corso, to Admiral Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
'''Te Corso''' was an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]] during both the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Before the [[Battle of Caamas|conclusion]] of the former conflict, she was a consultant to the ruling [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-allied [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], but the two organizations were ultimately defeated by the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] in [[130 ABY]]. The Jedi were then [[Massacre at Ossus|massacred]] by the [[One Sith]], and their survivors, including Corso, were forced into hiding as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|seized]] control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Corso found her way to a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taivas]] before [[137 ABY]]; by that [[Time/Legends|time]] a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], she helped rebuild a broken order.

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] dispatched Corso with fellow Jedi Masters [[Sayar Dun'La]], [[Asaak Dan]], and [[Drok]] to meet with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. Shortly after they arrived in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] and boarded the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|flagship]] of the Remnant [[Core Fleet|fleet]], an [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|attack]] came from the two groups' common enemy: [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. Corso and Drok [[Starfighter combat/Legends|flew]] [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter]]s alongside the Remnant's own forces in a defensive action as the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] prepared to flee, and after a series of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps, they were able to help shake the Sith&ndash;Imperial pursuit. An [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|alliance]] against [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Empire was solidified, and the Jedi ambassadors remained with Stazi over the following [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].

Corso later organized and led the volunteer [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]] during the Remnant's [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] following the [[Final Protocol|poisoning]] of its [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] by the Sith&ndash;Imperials. With aid from their allies in the [[Empire-in-exile]], the Jedi and Remnant forces saved 20 percent of the [[Water/Legends|water]] world's residents, and Corso returned to Taivas. When [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt [[138 ABY|soon afterward]] learned of the Hidden Temple's location, the entire Alliance made a stand against the Imperial [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|onslaught]], and Corso was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of a powerful [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith trooper]] while [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|protecting]] Jedi Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]]. The time bought by Corso's sacrifice allowed Saa to gather energy and release a [[beam of light]] into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the moment of her own death, which created an escape corridor for the overmatched Alliance.

==Biography==
===Before the storm===
{{Quote|I know Te Corso&mdash;She visited Coruscant to consult with my father and the rest of the Triumvirate, Admiral.|Ona Antilles|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
[[File:Hornylittleshedevil.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Te Corso, Jedi Master]]
The [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] Te Corso lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], and she became a member of the [[New Jedi Order]]<ref name="Legacy 42" /> prior to the conflict's end.<ref name="Legacy 42" /><ref name="Legacy 20">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref> On at least one occasion, she visited the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to consult with the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]],<ref name="Legacy 42" /> the ruling body of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-allied [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Legacy 20" /> While on the capital, Corso additionally met [[Ona Antilles]], the young daughter of Triumvir [[Bail Antilles (Galactic Alliance)|Bail Antilles]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] was another advisor to the Triumvirate, but in [[130 ABY]], they ignored his urgings of caution and approved a plan to strike at the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] over the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="Legacy 20" />

An [[Battle of Caamas|Imperial trap]] at Caamas soundly defeated the [[Core Fleet|Alliance Fleet]] and cost them the war. [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|Concurrent]] [[Massacre at Ossus|attacks]] on the [[Temple of the Sith|Jedi]] [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Temples]] of Coruscant and [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] by the Empire's [[One Sith]] allies decimated the order's ranks<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> and scattered its survivors,<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> including Corso,<ref name="Legacy 42" /> across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /> The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|seized]] control of the Empire and spent the next seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[Third Jedi Purge|hunting]] Jedi down,<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> but by [[137 ABY]], Corso had made her way to a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Taivas]], where the order worked to covertly rebuild its ranks.<ref name="Legacy 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>

In 137 ABY, the temple was visited by a delegation of [[Imperial Knight]]s representing [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], whose [[Empire-in-exile]] opposed the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] from which he had been ousted.<ref name="Legacy 25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> Corso was on Taivas<ref name="Legacy 26" /> when the [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] proposed an alliance to the skeptical [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]], who wrongly believed that Marasiah's [[Parent/Legends|father]] had ordered the attack on Ossus.<ref name="Legacy 25" /> Although her fellow Knights left Taivas to assist the former Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]] on a [[Mission to Had Abbadon|mission]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]], the princess remained at the temple to continue her negotiations.<ref name="Legacy 26" />

===Forging friendship under fire===
{{Quote|I had thought your order broken, dead, or scattered.''"<br />"''Largely true, although some Jedi have made a refuge and established a new council. The council feels it is time to again take an active part in the struggle against the Sith.|Gar Stazi and Te Corso|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
[[File:Canweuseyourbathroom.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Corso leads a Jedi delegation to the Galactic Alliance Remnant.]]
Severely [[Battle on Had Abbadon|injured]] by Skywalker's strike team, Krayt was taken to the brink of [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Legacy 31">[[Legacy (2006) 31|''Legacy'' (2006) 31]]</ref> and believed fully dead by the Jedi Council.<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Around the same time, the Empire-in-exile formally allied with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants]] of the Galactic Alliance,<ref name="Legacy 35">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref> and the council decided that the time had come for the Jedi to take an active part in the ongoing [[Second Imperial Civil War|war]] against the Sith&ndash;Imperials. Corso, by then a Jedi Master, was chosen as an emissary and sent to meet with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, along with fellow Masters [[Sayar Dun'La]], [[Asaak Dan]], and [[Drok]]. Princess Marasiah provided a [[Holomessage/Legends|holomessage]] to vouch for them and prove that they were not Sith in disguise. The four Masters formed a [[Squad Three-Zero-One|squadron]] of [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter]]s and rendezvoused with the Remnant [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], stationed in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />

The Jedi were cleared to land in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of Stazi's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], where they were greeted by the Admiral and several other Remnant [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. Corso introduced herself and her fellows, and her identity was confirmed to a wary Stazi by Ona Antilles, who now served the Remnant as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. After Corso informed the Admiral of the council's intentions, she was interrupted by Imperial Knight [[Sigel Dare]], who had come to the ''Alliance'' to request the use of a captured Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Corso suggested retiring to a private location and invited the Imperial Knight to come, but Dare was eager to reach the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and retrieve her stranded comrade [[Treis Sinde]]. Intrigued by Sinde's role in helping Dac's [[Mon Calamari Rangers|resistance groups]] fight the world's occupying Sith&ndash;Imperial forces, Dan joined her, and the three remaining Jedi followed Stazi to the ''Alliance''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />

On the bridge of the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], Corso [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] something amiss [[Standard second|seconds]] before the Sith&ndash;Imperial [[First Coruscant Task Force]] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The traitorous [[Shipman]] [[Tealart]] had kept the ''Alliance''{{'s}} deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] alarms off, and he used the distraction to shoot Stazi in the back just before being [[Cho mai/Legends|maimed]] by Drok's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Stazi's second in command, [[Jhoram Bey]], began to shout orders as Dun'La took the Admiral to [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]], and Corso volunteered both herself and Drok to join the Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]' rear-guard defensive action as the fleet prepared for [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. Bey allowed it, and the two Jedi added their Twintails to the Remnant's [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]] complement; the group [[Starfighter combat/Legends|defended]] against [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|attacking]] [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] until the fleet was ready. After releasing [[anti-ion emission tracer]]s, the Remnant forces jumped to a rendezvous point in the [[Opoku system]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />

The fleet was followed by the Imperials, however, who were tracing the frequency vibrations of the ''Alliance''{{'s}} [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]]. Bey commanded another hyperjump, during which he was advised of the Imperials' tactic by a barely-conscious Stazi. After arriving in the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]], the entire fleet save for the ''Alliance'' was ordered out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] as Bey shut down the array. Corso, Drok, and the rest of the fleet promptly returned to trap the arriving Imperials, who quickly fled into hyperspace themselves. The starfighters were recalled and the fleet left the system.<ref name="Legacy 42" /> A formal alliance was struck,<ref name="Legacy 43">[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]]</ref> and Corso and her brethren remained with the Remnant forces<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref> over the following [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] as Stazi recovered from his injury.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

===Race against time===
{{Quote|The Jedi know a haven that can accept the refugees. In addition, enough Jedi have arrived with our fighters that we can form a squadron&mdash;Sword Squadron&mdash;at your disposal, Admiral.''"<br />"''Excellent, Master Te Corso. Then, to continue with our plan&mdash;|Corso and Stazi, prior to the evacuation of Dac|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
[[File:Youreonyourownkid.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Corso looks on as Admiral Stazi prepares to evacuate Dac.]]
Shortly after the battle, the Remnant's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] discovered that the Sith&ndash;Imperials had [[Final Protocol|poisoned]] the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Dac. Volunteers from across the galaxy flocked to Stazi's banner as he arranged a massive [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]], and Corso stood on the ''Alliance''{{'s}} bridge with the Admiral as he appealed to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]] of the Empire-in-exile for help. Without word from his Emperor,<ref name="Legacy 47" /> who was out of contact while [[Mission to Agamar|negotiating]] with Jedi representatives on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]],<ref name="Legacy 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref> Jaeger was unable to send aid. Corso, however, shared Jedi knowledge of a potential safe haven for the refugees, and additionally offered to organize an ersatz [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of Jedi who had arrived with the volunteers. Stazi consented and quickly formulated a plan.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

[[Sword Squadron (Jedi)|Sword Squadron]], as Corso dubbed it, worked in cooperation with the Rogues and infiltrated the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. They took control of the [[Shipyard/Legends|yards']] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacements while [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] and [[Space warfare/Legends|space forces]] eliminated the minimal remaining Imperial resistance. The volunteer [[Emergency evac fleet]] then spent ten [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] evacuating the [[Water/Legends|water]] world's residents, after which time Imperial reinforcements arrived in the form of the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]], whose guns turned on the fleeing refugees. Sword Squadron and the other present starfighter groups fought back, and the Sith&ndash;Imperials fled after General Jaeger&mdash;having finally received word from Fel&mdash;arrived with a fleet of his own. With the Empire-in-exile's help, twelve more hours of evacuation allowed 20 percent of Dac's population to be saved before the effects of the [[Viral spore|poison]] engulfed the entire planet.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

===Enemy at the gates===
{{Quote|Masters Dun'La, Te Corso, Drok&mdash;stick with Cade and me. Cover Master Saa until she's ready. Everyone else&mdash;''move out!''|Rawk, while defending the Hidden Temple|<ref name="Legacy War 4" />}}
[[File:DeathofTeCorso.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Corso is slain while defending the Hidden Temple.]]
In early [[138 ABY]], Corso, Dun'La, and Drok returned to Taivas.<ref name="Legacy War 4" /> With a three-way [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|Alliance]] against [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt's Empire solidified,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> a group of Imperial Knights visited the Hidden Temple; Cade Skywalker was close behind with another Knight: Master [[Antares Draco]], who had been [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by the Sith into revealing Taivas's location. Skywalker formulated a plan to trap the Sith&ndash;Imperials between the planet and the Alliance's combined fleets, and it was agreed to by Emperor Fel, Admiral Stazi, and the Jedi Council. The present Jedi and Imperial Knights,<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref> Corso included,<ref name="Legacy War 4" /> prepared their defense.<ref name="Legacy War 3" />

Taivas's [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] forces prevented the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attacking]] Imperial fleet from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbitally bombarding]] the planet, and a ground assault was consequently launched. A group of Jedi and Imperial Knights defended the temple's gates<ref name="Legacy War 3" /> while Corso, Dun'La, and Drok remained in the [[Council Chamber (Hidden Temple)|Council Chamber]] with Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]], who coordinated the engagement through [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. After the rest of the allied forces arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], a fully recovered Darth Krayt unleashed his secret weapon: an [[Army/Legends|army]] of powerful [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]], whose [[Annihilator-class starfighter|starfighters]] plowed through friendly and enemy forces alike on their way to the temple. The defenders of the gate fell back to the Council Chamber, where Corso, Dun'La, and Drok joined them in a stand against their new foes.<ref name="Legacy War 4" />

The Jedi and Imperial Knights [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|resisted]] the lightsabers of their mysterious attackers, and Skywalker's uncle [[Rawk]] quickly ordered the majority of the group to escape. Corso, Dun'La, and Drok remained with the Skywalkers to protect Master Saa, who was gathering large amounts of energy. Corso was killed when a Sith [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] slashed her across the chest, and Dun'La and Drok were similarly felled. Their sacrifices allowed Master Saa to survive until a Sith trooper's starfighter crashed into the Council Chamber, at which point she and Rawk focused the gathered energy into a [[beam of light]]. The light shot into space, destroying enemy vessels and creating an escape corridor for the overmatched ships of the Alliance, who used the opportunity to flee from the seemingly-invincible Sith troopers.<ref name="Legacy War 4" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Still, I respect what you do&mdash;assuming you ''are'', in fact, Jedi&mdash;and not ''Sith'' in disguise. If you don't mind my saying so.''"<br />"''Not at all, Admiral. Admirable caution and tact.|Stazi and Corso|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
Te Corso was quick to take action during military emergencies and provide her services as a starfighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /><ref name="Legacy 47" /> She volunteered to fly for the Galactic Alliance Remnant before formally striking an alliance with them; Corso additionally referred to the Empire-in-exile as the "true Imperial forces" despite the fact that they had no official partnership with the Jedi. Her judgment was trusted by both the Galactic Alliance Triumvirate and the Jedi Council. Corso took no offense when Gar Stazi suggested that she could be a Sith in disguise, instead expressing admiration of the Admiral's caution and tact. She had magenta-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin, purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and four horns on the top of her head.<ref name="Legacy 42" /> In 137 ABY, Corso used a blue-bladed lightsaber;<ref name="Legacy 26" /> one year later, she favored a green blade.<ref name="Legacy War 4" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Admiral Stazi, something is not right&hellip; I sense&mdash;|Corso, prior to the arrival of a Sith&ndash;Imperial task force|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
A Jedi Master, Corso was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She was able to sense the impending arrival of an enemy task force from hyperspace and was additionally an apt pilot.<ref name="Legacy 42" /><ref name="Legacy 47" /> While defending the Hidden Temple, Corso was killed in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by one of Darth Krayt's Sith troopers.<ref name="Legacy War 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tecorsosketch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Te Corso appeared on multiple rough drafts of ''Star Wars: Legacy 42''{{'s}} cover.]]
{{Quote|Originally they were going to join Cade on the kill Krayt mission. Then sanity prevailed as we realized we had just too many characters so we took them out. The cover was already done. (They get done in advance of the actual issue for promotional purposes.) Every once in a while, that will happen but we try to keep it to a minimum.|John Ostrander, on Corso and the other Jedi who appear on the cover of ''Star Wars: Legacy 26''|<ref name="forums">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28816293|board=Literature|thread=Legacy #26: The Hidden Temple, part 2 (of 2)|user=[[John Ostrander|jfostrander01]]|date=2008-07-23|time=8:46 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304152321/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/legacy-26-the-hidden-temple-part-2-of-2.28287244/page-4}}</ref>}}
Te Corso is a character in ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series penned by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]]. She first appeared in [[2008]] on the cover of the series' [[Legacy (2006) 26|twenty-sixth issue]] along with Dun'La, Dan, and Drok, in a drawing done by [[Omar Francia]]. However, none of the four were included in the issue itself.<ref name="Legacy 26" /> Ostrander and Duursema originally intended that they would accompany Skywalker on his mission to assassinate Darth Krayt<ref name="forums" />&mdash;a mission that was launched in the issue<ref name="Legacy 26" /> and fulfilled in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Vector]]'' story arc, released later in the year<ref name="Vector">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Vector]]''</ref>&mdash;but they were ultimately dropped from the storyline due to a surplus of characters already on Skywalker's strike team.<ref name="forums" />

Corso made her first appearance proper in [[2009]] when she played a large role in ''Legacy''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 42|forty-second issue]], penciled by [[Dave Ross]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Two of artist [[Chris Scalf]]'s rough drafts of the issue's cover included Corso,<ref name="cover">{{DeviantArt|username=chrisscalf|url=chrisscalf/art/Rough-sketch-Jedi-128721714|name=[[Chris Scalf]]|text=Rough sketch: Jedi&hellip;|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="cover2">{{DeviantArt|username=chrisscalf|url=chrisscalf/art/Legacy-Cover-42-roughs-196137288|name=[[Chris Scalf]]|text=Legacy Cover 42 roughs|nolive=1}}</ref> but the final version featured only Drok and Gar Stazi.<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Corso later appeared in ''Legacy''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 47|forty-seventh issue]], released in [[2010]],<ref name="Legacy 47" /> and the [[Legacy — War 4|fourth issue]] of ''Legacy''{{'s}} followup miniseries, [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']], released in [[2011]]. Both issues were penciled by Jan Duursema.<ref name="Legacy War 4" /><ref name="Legacy 47" /> In the latter issue, Corso uses a green-bladed lightsaber,<ref name="Legacy War 4" /> but the cover of ''Legacy 26'' shows her wielding a blue-bladed weapon.<ref name="Legacy 26" /> However, the issues are set in different years, and this article treats both colors as [[canon]]ical.
